history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity EQC Load details.

events.description: Opens the EQC Load pop up screen for the selected PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Empty Container Load >> EQC Load

events.description: Selects the container records to be loaded; the header check box selects all records
events.triggered_when: User selects the check box of one or more container records in the pop up grid

events.description: Clears the query fields of the EQC Load pop up
Loads the selected containers to the PR. A success or error message is shown
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after selecting records

events.description: Closes the EQC Load pop up
events.triggered_when: User clicks × on the pop up title bar
